invalid_argument.title: Invalid argument
invalid_argument.hint: Check command flags or query syntax with `veri --help`.

no_provider.title: No provider available
no_provider.hint: Run `veri key set <provider>` (e.g. deepseek, exa, tinyfish) or set its API key environment variable, then verify with `veri doctor`.

auth_failed.title: Authentication failed
auth_failed.hint: Verify your API key; update via `veri key set <provider>` or inspect sources with `veri key list`.

not_enabled.title: Service not enabled
not_enabled.hint: Enable the service in the provider console and run `veri doctor`.

insufficient_balance.title: Insufficient balance or quota
insufficient_balance.hint: Check your provider account quota or switch to another provider with `-p`.

rate_limited.title: Rate limit exceeded
rate_limited.hint: Wait briefly before retrying or configure multiple API keys for automatic rotation.

upstream_timeout.title: Upstream request timed out
upstream_timeout.hint: Retry with a larger `--timeout` or switch to another provider.

upstream_unavailable.title: Upstream service unavailable
upstream_unavailable.hint: Check network connectivity or switch to another provider with `-p`.

upstream_bad_response.title: Invalid upstream response
upstream_bad_response.hint: Retry later or switch to another provider with `-p`.

blocked_by_policy.title: Blocked by policy
blocked_by_policy.hint: Refine the query or try a different target URL.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.hint: Check the URL spelling or confirm whether the page was moved or removed.

content_unavailable.title: Page content unavailable
content_unavailable.hint: Verify that the target URL is publicly reachable and serves text/HTML content.

internal.title: Internal error
internal.hint: Re-run with `VERI_LOG_LEVEL=debug` for detailed diagnostic logs.

cli.root.short: Multi-provider web search and Markdown extraction tool (CLI + MCP + Skill)
cli.root.long:
veri is a multi-provider web search and clean Markdown page extraction tool for AI agents and developers.
Passing query arguments directly to the root command runs `veri search`.
cli.root.example:
veri key set deepseek
  veri "golang context cancellation"
  veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go --section "Concurrency"
  veri search "mcp sdk" -s github.com --json
cli.help.more_search_flags: For advanced filter & fusion flags, run: veri search --help
cli.help.footer: Use "{cmd} <command> --help" for more information about a command.
cli.flag.ui_lang: Terminal UI language: auto | zh | en
cli.flag.quiet: Quiet mode; suppress diagnostic and fallback notes on stderr
cli.search.short: Search the web and return structured results
cli.search.example:
veri search "golang sync.Map" -n 5
  veri search "mcp protocol" -s github.com -t 3m --json
  veri search "llm benchmarks" -F -p exa,brave
cli.search.flag.provider: Target search provider(s), comma-separated (single provider disables fallback)
cli.search.flag.fusion: Query multiple providers concurrently and fuse via RRF
cli.search.flag.freshness: Time range: day | week | month | year, 7d | 3m | 1y, or 2026-08-01..2026-08-31
cli.search.flag.lang: Content language filter (ISO 639-1 codes, comma-separated, e.g. zh,en)
cli.search.flag.detail: Result detail level: snippet | summary | content
cli.search.flag.question: Original question context for providers supporting semantic ranking
cli.search.flag.json: Output in JSON format (shorthand for --format json)
cli.search.flag.format: Output format: md | json | jsonl | urls
cli.search.flag.extra: Include site icon and provider-specific extra metadata in JSON output
cli.search.flag.strict: Strict filtering: only use providers with native filter support
cli.fetch.short: Fetch one or more URLs and extract main content as Markdown
cli.fetch.example:
veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go
  veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go --section "Concurrency"
  veri fetch https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk/blob/main/README.md
  veri search -q --format urls "golang mcp" | veri fetch -
cli.fetch.flag.provider: Target fetch provider(s), comma-separated (single disables fallback; conflicts with --strategy)
cli.fetch.flag.strategy: Fetch routing strategy: api_first | smart_local | local_only | api_only
cli.fetch.flag.section: Extract only the Markdown section matching the heading (including subsections)
cli.fetch.flag.match: Extract matching paragraphs or code line windows with context
cli.fetch.flag.max_chars: Maximum characters returned per page (0 = full content)
cli.fetch.flag.offset: Starting character offset for paginated reading
cli.fetch.flag.fresh: Force live upstream extraction (also bypasses MCP cache)
cli.fetch.flag.json: Output in JSON format (shorthand for --format json)
cli.providers.short: List built-in providers, credential sources, and parameters
cli.providers.flag.json: Output provider status list as JSON
cli.table.providers.name: NAME
cli.doctor.short: Check configuration, credential permissions, DNS resolution, and connectivity
cli.doctor.example:
veri doctor
  veri doctor --json
  veri doctor --live --yes
cli.doctor.flag.live: Send one minimal live request per enabled search provider (may incur cost)
cli.doctor.confirm_live: Live checks send 1 real request per enabled search provider and may incur cost. Continue? [y/N]:
cli.doctor.config_missing: Config file: {path} (optional, using built-in defaults; run `veri config init` to customize)
cli.doctor.no_searcher_warn: WARNING: No search provider API key configured; run `veri key set deepseek` (or `exa` / `tinyfish`) or set an environment variable.
cli.doctor.perm_warn: WARNING: Config file contains plaintext secret(s) with permissive mode {mode}; run `chmod 600 {path}`.
cli.doctor.vault_perm_warn: WARNING: Encrypted credential files have permissive permissions; run chmod 600 on vault files in the config directory.
cli.doctor.private_warn: WARNING: network.allow_private=true disables local SSRF private-IP protection.
cli.doctor.fake_ip_detected: Network: TUN Fake-IP environment detected ({host} -> {ip}), Fake-IP allowlist active.
cli.doctor.summary_ok: All checks passed ({enabled} searchers, {fetchers} fetchers enabled).
cli.config.example:
veri config init
  veri config path
  veri config show --json
cli.config.init.short: Generate a commented config.toml template in the config directory
cli.config.path.short: Print the active configuration file path
cli.config.show.short: Print merged effective configuration with redacted secrets
cli.config.show.flag.json: Output redacted effective configuration as JSON
cli.key.example:
veri key set deepseek
  veri key list
  veri key unset deepseek
cli.key.set.short: Encrypt and store an API key for a provider
cli.key.set.long: Encrypt and store an API key for a provider. Uses hidden prompt interactively, or reads from stdin when piped.
cli.key.set.example:
veri key set deepseek
  veri key set exa
cli.key.set.done: Encrypted and saved API key for {provider} in {path}
cli.key.unset.short: Remove the stored encrypted API key for a provider
cli.key.unset.done: Removed encrypted API key for {provider} from {path}
cli.key.unset.none: No encrypted API key stored for {provider}.
cli.key.list.short: List active credential sources and local encryption status
cli.key.list.flag.json: Output credential sources and encryption status as JSON
cli.mcp.short: Start the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
cli.mcp.example:
veri mcp
  veri mcp config
  veri mcp config --full-path
cli.mcp.stdio_ready: note: MCP stdio server listening on stdin for JSON-RPC messages (Ctrl+C to exit).
cli.mcp.config.short: Print a client-ready mcpServers JSON configuration snippet
cli.mcp.config.flag.full_path: Use the absolute path of the current veri binary in command
cli.skill.short: Print or install the embedded Agent SKILL.md
cli.skill.long: Print or install the embedded Agent SKILL.md. Prefer `npx skills add maybk/veri` for unified multi-agent install and updates; use `install` or `print` directly offline.
cli.skill.example:
npx skills add maybk/veri
  veri skill install
  veri skill install --project
  veri skill print
cli.skill.install.short: Write embedded SKILL.md to .agents/skills or a custom directory
cli.skill.install.flag.project: Install into the current workspace (.agents/skills) instead of user home
cli.version.flag.json: Output version and build metadata as JSON
cli.update.short: Check for updates and upgrade veri to the latest release
cli.update.long: Check and update veri from official GitHub Releases with checksum verification and atomic replacement. For package-manager installs (e.g. Homebrew, Scoop, WinGet, npm, mise), prints the native upgrade command instead.
cli.update.example:
veri update
  veri update --check
  veri update --version v0.2.0
  veri update --check --json
cli.update.flag.version: Target a specific stable version (e.g. v0.2.0)
cli.update.flag.mirror: HTTPS mirror prefix for archive download (overrides VERI_UPDATE_MIRROR)
cli.update.flag.force: Force re-download and replace even when up to date or on a dev build
cli.update.flag.json: Output check or update result as JSON
cli.update.check.hint_managed: Managed by package manager; run `{command}` to upgrade.
cli.update.check.hint_system: Installed in a system directory; upgrade via your system package manager.
cli.update.check.target_older: Current version is {current}; target stable release is {target}.
cli.note.perm_warn: warning: config file {path} has permissive permissions; recommend `chmod 600`
cli.note.fetch_truncated: note: content truncated ({shown}/{total} chars shown); pass `{continue}` to continue.
cli.note.fetch_truncated_outline: note: content truncated ({shown}/{total} chars shown); use `{continue}` to continue, or `--section` / `--match` to narrow. Outline: {outline}
cli.err.invalid_ui_lang: unsupported UI language "{lang}" (valid: auto, zh, en)
cli.hint.invalid_freshness: Use day | week | month | year, 7d | 2w | 3m | 1y, or date ranges like 2026-08-01..2026-08-31.
cli.err.invalid_detail: invalid detail level "{value}" (valid: snippet, summary, content)
cli.err.invalid_search_strategy: invalid search strategy "{value}" (valid: auto, single, fusion)
cli.err.invalid_fetch_strategy: invalid fetch strategy "{value}" (valid: api_first, smart_local, local_only, api_only)
cli.err.invalid_count: result count {count} out of valid range ({min}-{max})
cli.err.secret_as_query: refusing to send an apparent API key or token as a search query
cli.hint.secret_as_query: To save an API key, run `veri key set <provider>`.
cli.hint.config_key_moved: Use `veri key set <provider>` or `veri key unset <provider>`.
cli.hint.legacy_subcommand: Use `veri key set <provider>`, `veri config init`, or `veri skill install`.
cli.hint.url_as_query: Run `veri fetch <url>` to extract page content, or `veri search -- <url>` to search literally.
cli.hint.unknown_subcommand_suggest: Run `veri {suggest}`, or use `veri search -- {cmd}` to search literally.
cli.hint.doctor_live_noninteractive: Pass `--yes` to confirm live requests: `veri doctor --live --yes`.
cli.err.empty_api_key: API key must not be empty
cli.hint.empty_api_key: Paste a valid API key and press Enter, or press Ctrl+C to cancel.
cli.err.unsupported_mcp_transport: unsupported MCP transport "{transport}" (only stdio is supported)
cli.hint.use_force: Pass `--force` to overwrite the existing file.
cli.hint.unknown_config_keys: Check spelling in config.toml or run `veri config show` to inspect supported fields.
cli.hint.vault_decrypt_failed: Check file permissions or re-save the damaged credential via `veri key set <provider>`.
cli.hint.strict_filter_empty: Disable `--strict` filtering or relax filter conditions.
cli.hint.multi_provider_failed: Run `veri key list` or `veri doctor` to inspect provider credentials, quota, and connectivity.
cli.hint.js_wall_need_api: Run `veri key set tinyfish` (or deepseek / tavily) to enable a cloud fetch provider for dynamic pages.
cli.hint.local_only_js_wall: Target requires dynamic rendering or anti-bot handling under `local_only`; retry with `api_first` or pick a cloud extractor with `-p`.
cli.hint.challenge_detected: Target blocked direct HTTP access with an anti-bot challenge; configure a cloud fetch provider (e.g. `veri key set tinyfish` or `tavily`).
cli.hint.ssrf_private_blocked: Local fetching blocks loopback, private, and link-local addresses by default; set `network.allow_private = true` in config.toml if intentional.
cli.err.private_url_cloud_blocked: refusing to send local or private URL to external cloud extractor
cli.hint.private_url_cloud_blocked: Use local extraction (`api_first`, `smart_local`, or `-p local`) and set `network.allow_private = true` in config.toml if needed.
cli.err.local_disabled_private_url: local extractor is disabled in config and cannot read private or local URLs
cli.hint.local_disabled_private_url: Set `providers.local.enabled = true` and `network.allow_private = true` in config.toml if needed.
cli.err.invalid_url: URL must be a valid http or https address without credentials
cli.hint.fetch_providers_strategy_conflict: Omit `--strategy` when selecting providers explicitly, or drop `-p` to use automatic routing.
cli.hint.missing_search_query: Provide at least one search term, e.g. `veri search "golang context"`.
cli.hint.missing_fetch_url: Provide one or more http/https URLs, or pass `-` to read URLs from stdin.
cli.err.too_many_args: too many positional arguments: expected at most {max}, got {count}
cli.err.key_positional_secret: API key cannot be passed as a positional argument
cli.hint.key_positional_secret: Run `veri key set <provider>` interactively or pipe the key via stdin.
cli.err.batch_max_urls: too many URLs for batch fetch ({count}, max {max})
cli.err.update_invalid_mirror: invalid mirror URL "{mirror}" (must be an https:// prefix without credentials or query)
cli.hint.update_no_release: Wait for a published stable release on GitHub Releases, or build from source.
cli.hint.update_version_not_found: Verify the version tag on GitHub Releases, or run `veri update --check` to see the latest release.
cli.err.update_unsupported_platform: no prebuilt archive is available for {platform}
cli.hint.update_unsupported_platform: Build from source, or check GitHub Releases for supported platforms.
cli.hint.update_asset_missing: Check GitHub Releases for your platform archive, or build from source.
cli.hint.update_check_failed: Check your network or proxy settings and retry.
cli.hint.update_download_failed: Check your network or proxy settings and retry, or pass `--mirror <https-url>` for archive downloads.
cli.err.update_checksum_mismatch: checksum verification failed for {asset}; update aborted

cli.err.update_install_failed: failed to extract or replace executable
cli.hint.update_permission_denied: Check write permissions on the install directory, or install to a user-writable directory.
cli.err.update_rollback_failed: replacement failed and rollback could not complete; backup kept at {backup}
cli.err.update_managed_install: {path} is managed by {method} and cannot be overwritten
cli.err.update_system_install: {path} is in a system directory and does not support self-update
